files.currentImplementedBehavior: Defines initial session status, action, truth, map, text, dialogue, save and snapshot records.
files.missingBehavior: Player, nearby content, encounter participants and turns, dialogue choices, quest objective detail, human save entries and migration preview projections are absent.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Reuses GeneratedGameplaySaveValidator under the shared gameplay-load lease and maps captured generated save truth into campaign truth.
files.missingBehavior: Needs explicit causal readiness diagnostics and focused proof that strict source, TRAVEL_CURRENT activation/travel, package/document bytes, authoring, identity and bindings all gate readiness.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Projects a finite map plus basic resources, stats, progression, inventory, equipment, quests, dialogue, factions, events and technical hashes.
files.missingBehavior: Projection omits player and nearby context, encounter state, dialogue choices and speaker titles, objective detail, save status, multiple entities per cell and complete raw-ID isolation.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Plans finite-map movement, a nearby interaction, dialogue choices, a basic encounter action set, region encounters and completable quests over existing Runtime commands.
files.missingBehavior: Encounter abilities and targets are not turn- or participant-safe, dialogue close validity is assumed, region binding is weak, resolve and bounded AI are absent, action IDs can collide and causal follow-up planning is incomplete.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Presents Runtime map/gameplay/diagnostic messages in bounded recent-event order.
files.missingBehavior: Needs human fallbacks and preservation of command/follow-up event ordering without exposing raw codes in the primary projection.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Starts, refreshes, executes one projected command, saves, lists, continues and applies migration while retaining an in-memory session.
files.missingBehavior: It is still a thin compressed scaffold: no ClearSession, no AutoStart orchestration, no bounded EndTurn/AI/resolve flow, weak failure state handling, unconditional quest refresh categories, unsafe migration recapture, incomplete save truth and no explicit project-switch lifecycle.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Provides a singleton-compatible typed navigation request event without referencing MainForm.
files.missingBehavior: Needs behavioral coverage for requested, unknown and disposed-page navigation paths.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Paints projected map cells and emits clicked cell coordinates.
files.missingBehavior: Arbitrary dimensions can clip because there is no viewport offset or desired size; click coordinates can exceed bounds and no human cell tooltip/title is surfaced.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Binds snapshots, new/save/continue, adjacent click, keyboard movement and dynamic action buttons.
files.missingBehavior: Context/dialogue/encounter rendering, primary interaction fallback, text-input shortcut suppression, durable tooltips, status/save controls, human map titles and complete scroll/layout behavior are missing.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Creates a minimal three-column campaign page.
files.missingBehavior: The file violates the repository Designer contract through file-scoped namespace, compact runtime-style construction, loops, collection expressions and event wiring; required top/status/context/technical-toggle and 1100x720 layout are incomplete.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Allows CURRENT continue and migration-required selection from save entries.
files.missingBehavior: It displays only slot names, does not bind human status/world/revision/migration summaries and does not update action enablement from selection.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Creates a list and Continue/Migrate/Cancel buttons.
files.missingBehavior: The file violates the repository Designer contract and lacks structured human save columns, selection details, disabled-state layout and conservative CodeDOM-compatible initialization.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Registers campaign services/page and navigation as singletons and injects them into Projects and MainForm.
files.missingBehavior: Must remain synchronized with final constructor signatures and prove one shared session service survives page navigation.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Subscribes to typed navigation requests, selects a registered page and logs unknown IDs.
files.missingBehavior: Needs disposal-safe and UI-thread behavioral proof plus exact campaign-page selection without auto-start.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Adds a play handler that conditionally calls BuildAndQualify and requests campaign navigation.
files.missingBehavior: Readiness is reduced to Present/Passed flags instead of exact TRAVEL_CURRENT truth; button title/enabled/reason/busy states are not bound and legacy/template behavior is not completed.

files.currentImplementedBehavior: Adds a Designer-compatible Играть toolbar button in the existing Projects layout.
files.missingBehavior: Static control placement is sufficient, but runtime binding must supply truthful title, enabled state and human tooltip without changing unrelated layout.
